title: 📖 Histoire : Que ferais-tu ?
description: Une histoire utilisant le conditionnel, venir de et depuis.
storyIntro: Anne et Charles discutent de leurs rêves.

sentences.french: Anne, si tu étais riche, que ferais-tu ?
sentences.english: Anne, if you were rich, what would you do?

sentences.french: Si j'étais riche, je voyagerais partout.
sentences.english: If I were rich, I would travel everywhere.

sentences.french: J'irais en France et j'achèterais une maison.
sentences.english: I would go to France and I would buy a house.

sentences.french: Je rêve de ça depuis longtemps.
sentences.english: I have been dreaming of that for a long time.
And you, Charles? What would you do?
Me, I would study French cooking.

sentences.french: Je viens de lire un livre sur les chefs.
sentences.english: I just read a book about chefs.
